mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a highly accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% is associated with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when both UNRATE increases and PAYEMS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year during a monetary tightening cycle signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when both INDPRO decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
